items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: So I was playing with Lloyd at the time, and it was a big band in Atlanta, Georgia.

ctx.x: He was the A&R guy for Atlantic at that time. He was the other, one of their- Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. And he was one, he was one, fairly instrumental in aiding his career at Atlantic at the time. I just, I threw his name out to see if you-
Lloyd Price, didn't Lloyd Price record for Atlantic too? No, no.
No, he recorded for a specialty. Yes, that's a specialty. That's it. Did you work with Lloyd? Oh yeah, a lot of times.
